commit 4f2c9a1e8b3d5670a1c2e9f8b7d6c5a4e3f21098 (HEAD -> main, tag: v1.4.2)
Author: a platform engineer <redacted@example.com>
Date:   Fri Sep 18 13:41:02 2026 +0000

    feat(checkout): make shipping_cost optional for digital goods

    Digital goods have no shipping, so allow the column to be null rather than
    defaulting it to zero.

diff --git a/checkout/models.py b/checkout/models.py
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@ class Cart(Base):
     subtotal = Column(Numeric(10, 2), nullable=False)
-    shipping_cost = Column(Numeric(10, 2), nullable=False, default=Decimal("0.00"))
+    shipping_cost = Column(Numeric(10, 2), nullable=True)

commit 9a8b7c6d5e4f30291817263544536271890abcde (tag: v1.4.1)
Author: a platform engineer <redacted@example.com>
Date:   Thu Sep 17 09:12:44 2026 +0000

    chore: bump base image to python:3.12-slim

All 40 sampled errors share one traceback: Cart.shipping_cost is None when summed with subtotal. Release v1.4.2 (deployed 14:09Z, 14 minutes before the first error at 14:10Z) made shipping_cost nullable without updating the summation in handler.py line 142. Existing carts written before the change still have zeros, which is why the failure rate is partial rather than total. Cause is the v1.4.2 release.

outcome.details: Root cause identified: null shipping_cost introduced by v1.4.2 breaks order total calculation in checkout/handler.py:142. 4 evidence artifacts captured.
